housing: Augusta's rentals are mostly single-family houses and garden-style apartment complexes. Military families from Fort Eisenhower and medical staff and students at Augusta University are a large share of renters.

climate: Test the air conditioning and look for damp or mold in bathrooms and closets; long, humid summers make both common problems.
fact: During Masters week each April, some Augusta homeowners rent out their whole house to golf visitors.
